newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.
newsitem.headline: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.

text.p: Vacant primary space in Canadian Prairie elevators increased to 24 percent in the week ended May 11 while railcar unloads totaled 88 percent of their targeted levels, the Canadian Wheat Board said.
The average vacancy in Prairie elevators was tabbed at 23 percent April 20.
Manitoba and Saskatchewan elevators had the least space available at 23 percent each while Alberta elevators averaged 26 percent.
Vancouver unloaded 2,447 railcars, versus the 3,300 target. Prince Rupert unloaded 1,190 railcars versus 1,300 target.
Thunder Bay unloads totalled 3,119 hopper cars, exceeding the 3,075 target.
